scope: The mapped principal Broken Hill Mosque from the North Camel Camp, including the corrugated iron prayer room, attached anteroom and immediate entrance step and concrete washing channel.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The state identifies the main 1891 mosque and second relocated mosque as separate buildings at the historic site.
The Migration Heritage Centre records corrugated iron and timber with characteristic rust-red paint.
The operator identifies the principal mosque as a simple timber-and-iron structure in the North Camel Camp.
The historical trail describes the separate prayer room and anteroom within the principal building and the concrete channel used for ritual washing.
